trajectory_summary: The call opens cold but cooperative, sustains through a lengthy and increasingly frustrating bill-lookup detour, and ends with the customer withdrawing — citing a family emergency and a request to be removed from the contact list. The rep never converted the qualification data he did get (bill in the $60-100+ range, composite roof, 670+ credit) into a booked or even clearly tentative appointment; the call ends in a polite, unresolved opt-out.
outcome_dispute: No appointment day/time was ever offered or captured; the call ends with the customer requesting removal from contact lists. This should not be read as any form of booked/tentative outcome — it is a no_appointment call that closed with an opt-out request, which is a materially worse outcome than a soft callback.
